title: Black Hole Phenomena
definition: Phenomena and characteristics observed around black holes in space.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a place so strong that nothing can escape from it, not even light. That's a black hole. We've noticed strange things happening around these cosmic giants, and we're trying to understand why.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Black hole phenomena encompass a range of observational and theoretical effects such as gravitational lensing, Hawking radiation, and the formation of jets. Understanding these phenomena provides insights into the nature of space-time and the behavior of matter under extreme conditions.
difficulty_levels.expert: Black hole phenomena challenge our understanding of quantum mechanics and general relativity. The study of black hole phenomena also connects to areas such as high-energy physics, particle astrophysics, and computational astrophysics. Novel insights include the possibility of black hole information paradox and the role of black holes in cosmic evolution.

extra_fields.insight: Black holes act as windows into understanding the fundamental laws of nature and their interplay under extreme conditions.
